incident_updates.body: We have identified the issue and are implementing a fix. We are seeing improvements across affected regions. We will continue to provide further updates as they become available.

The impact is not limited to the regions initially identified. Only a subset of projects are affected. Affected projects may continue to experience increased connection errors or database unavailability. We are continuing to investigate and will provide further updates as more information becomes available.
We continue to investigate the root cause of this issue and will provide updates as more information becomes available.
We have observed increased connection errors, some databases may be unavailable with all services unhealthy.

incidents.name: Elevated Error rates for All Supabase project APIs

incident_updates.body:
We are currently seeing slightly increased error rates for API requests to the Data APIs, Auth, Storage, and other HTTP API routes across all regions

The team is currently investigating.

We will be carrying out a scheduled maintenance window to perform internal platform improvements and upgrades.

Maintenance Window:

• Start time: 03:00 UTC on July 2, 2026

• End time: 04:00 UTC on July 2, 2026

Impact:

• Various platform operations will be delayed during this window

• These may include project creation and initial configuration/setup

• All affected operations will be rescheduled at the end of the window to ensure no operation is dropped
